last.summary:
Implementation and tests are right; one citation is wrong and needs fixing.

Checked: `verify.sh` passes on the PR head ("verify: packages: ok" ... "verify: test: ok", "verify: ok"). The task names no check-task. Against the merge-base the change touches only the task's Files (Blocks.lean, CompressBlocks.lean, vectors/compress-blocks/*); the fuzz/lakefile deletions seen in a diff against current origin/master are just master having moved on. I regenerated all 28 vectors out of tree with generate.py from upstream/ and they are byte-identical to the committed ones.

Spot-checked against the C: nblockMAX = 100000*level-19 (bzlib.c:194); the full-block test is before each byte read (298/314) and the pending run is not flushed at close, so it goes to the next block and its CRC (390-393, 220-222); count byte `len-4` marked in inUse (238); runs cut at 255 (276); fast path equals add_pair with len 1 (264-272 vs 225-227); empty input gives no block (compress.c:604/630); the oneShot vs program difference at a block that is full exactly after the last byte (flush_RL first when avail_in_expect==0 at 384-386, versus close at 390 in the RUN+empty FINISH sequence). All match `split`. The other citations I read (131-135, 116-126, 159-161, 252-256, 260-284, 984-1003, 1048-1053, 1282, compress.c:606, bzlib_private.h:157-165) are correct.

Requested change: the module doc cites `BZ2_bzBuffToBuffCompress` as `bzlib.c:1250-1351`. That function is `bzlib.c:1250-1298`; 1302-1351 is `BZ2_bzBuffToBuffDecompress`. Change the range to `bzlib.c:1250-1298`.
